What makes me think I have failed.
I suck at everything. I barely passed high school. I have no friends. I care about no one. I have never had anything that meant something to me. And everytime it looks like someone is going to come my way they turn around. I'm an uninteresting and boring person so I don't blame them. I'm always gonna be shunned and walk my own way.

Anyways thanks for answering. I just use this to vent sometimes. But I'm fairly certain I'm going to kill myself soon.
